# bioexcel/biobb_amber/process_mdout

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) process_mdout tool module.

Parses the AMBER (sander) md output file (log) and dumps statistics that can then be plotted. Using the process_mdout.pl tool from the AmberTools MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [ProcessMDOut](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/process.html#module-process.process_mdout) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_PROCESS_MDOUT } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/process_mdout'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_PROCESS_MDOUT(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_log_path` | yes | log, out, txt, o | AMBER (sander) MD output (log) file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_dat_path` | yes | dat, txt, csv | Dat output file containing data from the specified terms along the minimization process |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ProcessMDOut properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_dat_path: 'dat']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_PROCESS_MDOUT' {
        ext.properties = [terms: 'VOLUME']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `terms` | array | "[ETOT]" | Statistics descriptors. Values: VOLUME, TSOLVENT, TSOLUTE, TEMP, PRES, ETOT, ESCF, EPTOT, EKTOT, EKCMT, DENSITY. |
| `binary_path` | string | "process_mdout.perl" | Path to the process_mdout.perl executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
